characters.intro: The men and women caught in the crossroads.

list.name: Fitz
list.tagline: Great War veteran turned security manager. Reluctant hero with unshakeable loyalty.

list.name: Lotte
list.tagline: German scholar driven from academia. Fighting the regime that destroyed her career.

list.name: Liz
list.tagline: Theatrical performer with perfect timing. Never met a dramatic moment she couldn't seize.

list.name: Milan
list.tagline: Archaeologist who uncovered more than ancient history. His discovery changed everything.
